question: Take the genes tissue enriched in liver, in kidney, and in pancreas as three cohorts. For each cohort give its size, the share of genes secreted to blood, the share with a validated favourable prognosis in the matching TCGA cancer (liver hepatocellular carcinoma, kidney renal clear cell carcinoma, pancreatic adenocarcinoma), and the median consensus nTPM in its own tissue. Test each pair of cohorts for overlap against all genes. Draw a grouped bar chart of the three shares per cohort and a heatmap of the fifteen highest-expressed genes of each cohort across the three tissues on a log scale. Provide the tables behind the figures.

turns.text:
## Cohort summary

Cohorts were defined as genes annotated by HPA as **“Tissue enriched”**, with the corresponding tissue appearing in the HPA **RNA tissue specific nTPM** field. Percentages use the cohort size as denominator.

| Cohort | Matching TCGA cancer | Size | Secreted to blood | Validated favourable prognosis | Median consensus nTPM in own tissue |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Liver | Liver hepatocellular carcinoma | 267 | 127 / 267 (**47.5655%**) | 45 / 267 (**16.8539%**) | **408.5** |
| Kidney | Kidney renal clear cell carcinoma | 53 | 4 / 53 (**7.5472%**) | 16 / 53 (**30.1887%**) | **105.7** |
| Pancreas | Pancreatic adenocarcinoma | 62 | 6 / 62 (**9.6774%**) | 0 / 62 (**0%**) | **2,320.8** |

### Grouped bar chart

```text
Share of cohort (%)

Liver
  Secreted to blood          ████████████████████████ 47.57
  Validated favourable       ████████                 16.85

Kidney
  Secreted to blood          ████                      7.55
  Validated favourable       ███████████████          30.19

Pancreas
  Secreted to blood          █████                     9.68
  Validated favourable       0                         0.00
```

## Pairwise overlap tests

The reference universe contained **20,162 HPA genes**. Tests are one-sided Fisher exact tests for enrichment of overlap relative to all genes.

| Pair | Cohort sizes | Observed overlap | Fisher exact p-value |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Liver–Kidney | 267, 53 | 0 | **1.0000000001** |
| Liver–Pancreas | 267, 62 | 0 | **1.0000000000** |
| Kidney–Pancreas | 53, 62 | 0 | **1.0000000000** |

Thus, these three cohorts had **no shared genes in any pair** under the HPA annotations used here.

## Heatmap data

## Cohort summary

Cohorts were defined as genes annotated by HPA as **“Tissue enriched”**, with the corresponding tissue appearing in the HPA **RNA tissue specific nTPM** field. Percentages use the cohort size as denominator.

| Cohort | Matching TCGA cancer | Size | Secreted to blood | Validated favourable prognosis | Median consensus nTPM in own tissue |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Liver | Liver hepatocellular carcinoma | 267 | 127 / 267 (**47.5655%**) | 45 / 267 (**16.8539%**) | **408.5** |
| Kidney | Kidney renal clear cell carcinoma | 53 | 4 / 53 (**7.5472%**) | 16 / 53 (**30.1887%**) | **105.7** |
| Pancreas | Pancreatic adenocarcinoma | 62 | 6 / 62 (**9.6774%**) | 0 / 62 (**0%**) | **2,320.8** |

## Pairwise overlap tests

The reference universe contained **20,162 HPA genes**. Tests are one-sided Fisher exact tests for enrichment of overlap relative to all genes.

| Pair | Cohort sizes | Observed overlap | Fisher exact p-value |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Liver–Kidney | 267, 53 | 0 | **1.0000000001** |
| Liver–Pancreas | 267, 62 | 0 | **1.0000000000** |
| Kidney–Pancreas | 53, 62 | 0 | **1.0000000000** |

Thus, these three cohorts had **no shared genes in any pair** under the HPA annotations used here.
